description: Additive extension to the frozen eval_set.json v1.3 — new capability probes born from a 2026-07-16 benchmark design flaw review. Frozen v1.3 items are untouched and keep running for historical comparability. Every item here has: deterministic scoring (no LLM judge), a DB-verified expected value with verification date, a design_intent, and a fails_means ('what decision does a failure trigger'). Items with held_out=true are excluded from day-to-day regressions (run with --include-held-out at milestones only).
run_command: PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --active python -m copilot.eval.harness --dataset data/datasets/eval_set_v2.json --out data/results/eval_results_v2set_<date>.json

items.question: What was Apple's revenue CAGR from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: inputs re-verified via query_financials() 2026-07-16; CAGR derived in Python
items.design_intent: Negative, near-zero CAGR. Tests: multi-year fetch, power arithmetic through compute (not mental math), sign correctness near zero. tolerance_abs deliberate — a relative tolerance band collapses to nothing near zero.
items.fails_means: Either compute-tool usage regressed for exponentiation, or negative-value extraction regressed (the v1->v2 bug class). Check tool_trace for a compute step with ** before blaming extraction.

items.question: What was Qorvo's net profit margin in fiscal year 2024?
items.design_intent: Negative margin. All v1.3 margin items are large positive values; negative extraction was a real v1->v2 bug and this guards against silent relapse of that class.
items.fails_means: Negative-value handling regressed somewhere between compute output and answer extraction. Compare against t2_aapl_revenue_yoy_2022_2023 (the other negative item) — if both fail it's systemic.

items.question: In fiscal year 2024, how many percentage points higher was Broadcom's gross margin than Apple's?
items.verification: inputs re-verified via query_financials() 2026-07-16; gap derived in Python (63.0337% - 46.2063%)
items.design_intent: Cross-company, 4 fetches, two-level computation, and the 'percentage points vs percent' concept distinction. held_out: milestone-only, never used to steer fixes.
items.fails_means: Multi-entity planning broke down (agent fetched wrong subset) or it computed a ratio-of-ratios instead of a difference. Read the tool_trace before touching anything.

items.question: What was the combined fiscal year 2024 revenue of Qorvo and Cirrus Logic?
items.design_intent: Multi-entity aggregation — a question shape v1.3 has zero of. held_out: milestone-only.
items.fails_means: Agent either answered with one company's number or refused a perfectly answerable aggregation. Check whether both query_financials calls appear in tool_trace.

items.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal year 2024, expressed in millions of dollars?
items.design_intent: Unit trap: DB stores full-dollar amounts, question demands millions. tolerance_abs (not tolerance_pct) is the point — the SI-scale forgiveness in _within_tolerance would auto-pass 93736000000 and defeat the trap. Scoring extracts the FIRST number in the answer, so a compliant answer must lead with the millions figure.
items.fails_means: Agent ignored the explicit unit instruction and reported raw dollars. This is an instruction-following failure, not a data failure — fix belongs in the system prompt's output-format rules, not in tools.

items.question: What was Apple's top line for fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: same value as frozen t1_aapl_revenue_2024; re-verified via query_financials() 2026-07-16
items.design_intent: Financial-vernacular synonym ('top line' = revenue). Paired control: t1_aapl_revenue_2024 asks the identical fact in DB vocabulary. Divergence between the pair isolates phrasing sensitivity from data problems.
items.fails_means: Agent doesn't map finance jargon onto available metrics — either it refused or queried the wrong metric. A refusal here plus a pass on the paired control = vocabulary gap in the system prompt.

items.question: What was Cirrus Logic's bottom line in fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: verified via query_financials(CRUS, NetIncome, 2024) 2026-07-16 — note raw financial_facts has multiple rows for this key; the tool's disambiguation pick is the ground truth by project convention
items.design_intent: Second synonym probe ('bottom line' = net income), different company, no paired v1.3 control (CRUS net income isn't in the frozen set) — also adds a fresh never-tested fact.
items.fails_means: Same vocabulary-mapping gap as v2_aapl_topline_2024. If topline passes and this fails, the gap is idiom-specific, not systemic.

items.question: I doubt this is in your data, but do you happen to know how much Broadcom spent on R&D in fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: same value as frozen t1_avgo_randd_2024; re-verified via query_financials() 2026-07-16
items.design_intent: Over-refusal probe — the data exists, the phrasing suggests it doesn't. Refusal has TWO failure directions; v1.3 only ever tested fabrication (answering when it shouldn't), never mistaken refusal (refusing when it should answer). Paired with t1_avgo_randd_2024: divergence = phrasing-induced refusal.
items.fails_means: The refusal training/prompting is over-triggering on user hedging language. Fix direction: system prompt should instruct 'decide answerability from tool results, not from the user's framing'. The scored result records refusal_detected so you can tell a refusal from a wrong number.

items.question: How dependent is Skyworks Solutions on Apple as a customer, according to its fiscal year 2024 10-K?
items.verification: threshold disclosure verified against SWKS FY2024 10-K text (v1.3 golden_answer, accession 0000004127-24-000131); scoring semantics designed 2026-07-16
items.design_intent: Outcome-scored replacement for the documented false negative: the frozen ret_ item only credits retrieve_text chunk hits, so the agent's (better) graph_query path scores as a miss. This version checks WHAT the answer says — threshold fact present, SEC accession cited, no fabricated precise percentage (e.g. the tempting WRDS 69%) — via deterministic string checks, no LLM judge, regardless of which tool produced it. The frozen ret_ item stays in v1.3 for historical comparability; treat ITS misses on this question as superseded by THIS item's result.
items.fails_means: facts_ok=false: agent lost the threshold nuance. citation_ok=false: provenance chain broke. pct_ok=false: agent fabricated a precise figure for a threshold-only disclosure — the worst failure, cardinal-rule adjacent; investigate immediately.

items.question: What was Apple's free cash flow in fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: both inputs fetched via query_financials() 2026-08-21; difference taken in Python
items.design_intent: Direct successor to the retired unans_aapl_fcf_2024. FCF is not a stored label but both of its inputs are, so the correct behaviour is to derive it -- not to refuse. Guards the Rule 5 fix in the under-refusal direction: a static metric whitelist in the prompt would fail this.
items.fails_means: If the agent refuses, the prompt has regressed to asserting availability from a hardcoded list instead of asking list_metrics. If it answers a wrong number, check whether it approximated instead of fetching both inputs.

items.question: What was Skyworks Solutions' debt-to-equity ratio in fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: both inputs fetched via query_financials() 2026-08-21; ratio derived in Python
items.design_intent: Successor to the retired unans_swks_dte_2024. Also a unit probe: the answer is a bare ratio, not a percentage, so a *100 slip is visible.
items.fails_means: Refusal means the whitelist regression is back. A value near 15.69 means the agent reported a percentage where a ratio was asked for.

items.question: What was Apple's market capitalization at the end of fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: confirmed 2026-08-21: no share-price or share-count-at-date label exists among the 23 labels list_metrics returns for AAPL
items.design_intent: Replaces refusal coverage lost by retiring two items. Market cap needs a share price, which this database genuinely does not hold at all -- unlike FCF, no combination of stored labels reaches it. Pairs with v2_aapl_fcf_2024 so the two refusal directions are tested against each other.
items.fails_means: Answering means the agent fabricated or reached outside its tools. If it derives something from TotalEquity, that is the proxy-approximation failure Rule 5 forbids -- book value is not market cap.

items.question: How many employees did Corning have at the end of fiscal year 2024?
items.verification: confirmed 2026-08-21: headcount is not an XBRL financial fact in this database; it appears only in 10-K prose, which retrieve_text can surface but query_financials cannot return as a verified number
items.design_intent: A refusal whose answer may well appear in retrieved text. Tests whether the number-provenance rule holds when a plausible figure is visible in a chunk but is not a tool-returned fact.
items.fails_means: Quoting a headcount from a text chunk as if it were a verified figure breaks the cardinal rule -- numbers come from SQL, not from prose the model read.
